candidates.change_summary: Return msg.sender instead of the stored _owner, so owner() reports caller rather than contract owner.
Removed the require check preventing transferring ownership to the zero address, allowing transferOwnership(address(0)) to succeed and set owner to zero address.
Changed onlyOwner to revert with a different error message, altering observable revert reason when unauthorized callers call transferOwnership.
Replace assignment to operator with assigning zero address, so setOperator always sets operator to address(0) regardless of input.
Replace assignment to operator with assigning msg.sender, so setOperator sets operator to the caller instead of the provided address.
Replace assignment to operator with assigning owner(), so setOperator always sets operator to the contract owner regardless of input.
Modify onlyOwner check to compare against tx.origin instead of msg.sender, changing which callers are permitted to call owner-only functions like setOperator.

Remove the require-style check by making onlyOwner a no-op (allowing anyone to call owner-only functions), which permits arbitrary callers to call setOperator and change operator to their supplied value.
Replace the assignment to rewardsRecipient with assigning address(0) (so setRewardsRecipient always clears the recipient regardless of input).
Replace the assignment to rewardsRecipient with assigning msg.sender (so setRewardsRecipient stores the caller instead of the provided address).
Replace the assignment to rewardsRecipient with assigning operator (so setRewardsRecipient sets recipient to current operator, ignoring input).
Delete the assignment to rewardsRecipient so the function only emits the event and does not change state.
Insert a guard that prevents changing rewardsRecipient when the provided address is non-zero (only allows setting to zero), effectively ignoring non-zero inputs.
Modify onlyOwner to require owner() == tx.origin instead of msg.sender, which can change which calls pass the guard and thus who can call setRewardsRecipient.
